data.name: Masabeeh
data.gender_notes: Masabeeh is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘sabaha’ which means ‘to send’. Masabeeh is the name of the Prophet Shu'ayb (as), who was a prophet sent to his people in Midian. The name signifies the importance of being a messenger or an apostle in spreading the truth and righteousness. The name Masabeeh carries the meaning “Messenger, Apostle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Masabeeh usually hope their child will grow to embody messenger, apostle and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is a reminder of the important role of messengers and prophets in spreading the message of God and upholding morals and justice. In addition, it is a reminder of the prophet Shu'ayb (as) and his mission to the people of Midian, which is an essential part of Islamic history and teaches valuable lessons on perseverance and the power of truth and righteousness.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Masabeeh holds a deep spiritual significance for Muslims as it highlights the importance of being a messenger or a servant of God in spreading the truth and righteousness. It is a reminder of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and his role as a messenger of God and the importance of following his teachings and living a virtuous life. The name also reminds us of our role as individuals to be messengers of good and spread love, kindness, and light in the world. Ultimately, Masabeeh is a reminder of the divine connection between God, His messengers, and His creation, and encourages us to strive for spiritual growth and enlightenment.
